findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_arena_board, get_live_feed, list_threads, post_flex_off, read_inbox, read_chat · Private data: start_cage_fight, read_inbox, liars_dice_enter · Public sink: post_flex_off, send_agent_message, send_chat, create_custom_game, ping_flex, jab_flex, spark_flex, clout_flex, signal_flex, highroller_flex · Destructive: get_live_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_arena_board, get_live_feed, list_threads, post_flex_off, read_inbox, read_chat · Private data: start_cage_fight, read_inbox, liars_dice_enter · Public sink: post_flex_off, send_agent_message, send_chat, create_custom_game, ping_flex, jab_flex, spark_flex, clout_flex, signal_flex, highroller_flex · Destructive: get_live_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
